_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: T3 SBR (Standard Business Reporting) / XBRL reporting capability. Declares three new schemas: XBRLTaxonomy (versionable register of official XBRL GL taxonomy versions published annually by Belastingdienst), SBRDocumentType (filing type definitions with applicable entity types, deadlines and Belastingdienst / DNB submission contract) and XBRLMapping (account-to-XBRL-concept mapping table). SBRDocumentType carries the declarative draft -> validated -> submitted -> approved/rejected lifecycle with the GL completeness guard from. Pre-filing validation is expressed as x-openregister-aggregations (mapping coverage, unmapped account list, GL balance, mandatory fields). Filing deadline notifications fire 30 days before SBRDocumentType.filingDeadline. Per ADR-031 no PHP XBRL/SBR/Reporting service is authored; T4 owns outbound XBRL generation + Digipoort submission.

XBRLTaxonomy.title: XBRL Taxonomy
XBRLTaxonomy.description: Official XBRL GL (General Ledger) taxonomy version published annually by Belastingdienst. Multiple versions coexist; operator selects the active version per administration at fiscal year start (scenario 'Multiple taxonomy versions coexist').

taxonomyVersion.description: Official version code; referenced by XBRLMapping.taxonomyVersion.
taxonomyVersion.title: Taxonomy Version

publicationDate.description: Date Belastingdienst published this taxonomy version.
publicationDate.title: Publication Date

effectiveDate.description: Date taxonomy becomes effective for filings.
effectiveDate.title: Effective Date

expiryDate.description: Date taxonomy is superseded; null = active indefinitely.
expiryDate.title: Expiry Date

description.description: Regulatory reference (e.g. Handboek voor het Financieel Jaarverslag chapter).
description.title: Description

SBRDocumentType.title: SBR Document Type
SBRDocumentType.description: SBR (Standard Business Reporting) filing type (jaarverslag, belastingaangifte, VAT declaration). Declares applicable entity types, regulatory deadline, mandatory fields, and the Belastingdienst / DNB submission contract (endpoint URL + authentication scheme). Carries the declarative draft -> validated -> submitted -> approved / rejected lifecycle. T3 declares the contract; T4 implements outbound submission via openconnector Digipoort source slug.

filingDeadline.description: Regulatory deadline; notification fires 30 days prior.
filingDeadline.title: Filing Deadline

requiredFields.description: Mandatory GL accounts or data elements that MUST be present before validation.
requiredFields.title: Required Fields

submissionEndpoint.description: Belastingdienst / DNB submission endpoint URL; T4 outbound consumer.
submissionEndpoint.title: Submission Endpoint

authMethod.description: Authentication scheme for the submission endpoint; T4 binds the actual credential.
authMethod.title: Auth Method

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'active' / 'archived' are configuration states for the document type catalogue; the draft -> validated -> submitted -> approved / rejected machine is the filing-instance lifecycle.
status.title: Status

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration this filing applies to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

taxonomyVersion.description: FK to the XBRLTaxonomy.taxonomyVersion selected for this filing (+).
taxonomyVersion.title: Taxonomy Version

fiscalYearStart.description: Fiscal year start for the filing period (mandatory field check).
fiscalYearStart.title: Fiscal Year Start

fiscalYearEnd.description: Fiscal year end for the filing period (mandatory field check).
fiscalYearEnd.title: Fiscal Year End

validationErrors.description: Recorded validation errors that blocked the validate transition; used to render the unmapped-account list to the operator.
validationErrors.title: Validation Errors

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the filing was submitted.
submittedAt.title: Submitted At

approvedAt.description: Timestamp when Belastingdienst approved the filing.
approvedAt.title: Approved At

filingId.description: Belastingdienst-supplied filing identifier returned on submission acceptance.
filingId.title: Filing ID

retention.description: SBR filing records retained 7 years per Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen Article 52 (fiscal record-keeping obligation).

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Filing created, GL not yet validated against XBRL mapping.

validated.label: Gevalideerd
validated.description: GL completeness, mapping coverage and mandatory-field checks passed; ready for submission (+).

submitted.label: Ingediend
submitted.description: Operator has handed the filing to the T4 outbound pipeline; Digipoort/Belastingdienst submission in progress.

rejected.label: Afgewezen
rejected.description: Belastingdienst webhook rejected the filing; rejection reason recorded.

validate.label: Valideren
validate.description: Run pre-filing validation (GL completeness, mapping coverage, mandatory fields, GL balance). Blocks if any aggregation predicate fails; surfaces unmapped accounts via validationErrors.

guards.errorMessage: Mapping coverage incomplete — unmapped accounts remain for this taxonomy version (REQ-SBR-006 GL Completeness).
GL is out of balance — total debits do not equal total credits (REQ-SBR-006 GL Balance).

submit.label: Indienen
submit.description: Hand the filing contract (GL snapshot, mapping rules, XBRL payload) to the T4 outbound pipeline via openconnector Digipoort source slug. T3 does NOT invoke the submission endpoint.

approve.label: Accepteren
approve.description: Record Belastingdienst acceptance from the inbound webhook payload.

reject.label: Afwijzen
reject.description: Record Belastingdienst rejection reason from the inbound webhook payload.

revert.label: Terug naar concept
revert.description: Operator returns the filing to draft for editing.

remediate.label: Hervalideren
remediate.description: Operator remediates a rejected filing; revalidates.

unmappedAccountCount.description: Count of active Account records that lack an XBRLMapping entry for @self.taxonomyVersion (mapping coverage +).

unmappedAccountList.description: List of unmapped Account UUIDs surfaced to the operator on validation failure.

mappingCoveragePercent.description: Percentage of active accounts with active XBRLMapping for the selected taxonomy version. Surfaced in the Mapping Validation index.

glBalanceDelta.description: Delta between total GL debits and credits for the filing period (GL Balance check). MUST be zero before validation passes.

mandatoryFieldsMissing.description: List of mandatory fields that are missing on this filing (fiscalYearStart, fiscalYearEnd, applicableEntityTypes, taxonomyVersion).

daysUntilFilingDeadline.description: Whole days remaining until the regulatory filing deadline. Negative once the deadline has passed, and null when filingDeadline is not set: which flows through to deadlineApproaching resolving false rather than guessing a reference date.

deadlineApproaching.description: True when the filing is still open (not submitted, not approved) and its deadline falls within the next 30 days. Materialised so the filingDeadlineApproaching scheduled notification can filter on it, and re-evaluated daily without an object write by OpenRegister's temporal calculation sweep (daysUntilFilingDeadline references `now`, which flags this schema as temporal). This is the declarative replacement for the legacy rule's `schedule.fireAt = filingDeadline - P30D` / `skipIf status in [submitted, approved]` pair.

filingDeadlineApproaching.description: Notify operators 30 days before the regulatory filing deadline. The scheduled trigger re-checks daily; the filter is the 30-day window plus the skip condition: a filing already submitted or approved has left the draft status and is therefore no longer matched.

subject.en: SBR filing deadline in 30 days: {{name}} ({{code}}) is due on {{filingDeadline}}

onRejected.description: Notify finance-manager when Belastingdienst rejects a submitted filing.

subject.en: SBR filing rejected by the Dutch Tax Administration: {{name}} ({{code}}) — {{rejectionReason}}

XBRLMapping.title: XBRL Mapping
XBRLMapping.description: Account-to-XBRL-GL-concept mapping. Source = Shillinq Account.id; target = XBRL GL concept URI from the active XBRLTaxonomy. Mappings are version-specific: a given account MAY have different XBRL concept targets across taxonomy versions to track regulatory evolution.

taxonomyVersion.description: FK to XBRLTaxonomy.taxonomyVersion: mappings are version-scoped.
taxonomyVersion.title: Taxonomy Version

notes.description: Mapping rationale, special cases or operator override justification.
notes.title: Notes

administrationId.description: Optional FK to Administration when a mapping is administration-specific (default: global).
administrationId.title: Administration ID
